x-e-m1-01.title: Ben ayyaana dhufaa? Hiika dhokataa deebii isaa qorachuu
x-e-m1-01.goal: Deebii Ben haasaa keessaa sarara tokko tokkoon qoodi, wanta murtaa'e fi wanta hafe addaan baasi, akkasumas 'ni dhufa' ykn 'hin dhufu' jedhee osoo hin mirkaneessin murtee kenni.
x-e-m1-01.material:
Haasaa Jisu fi Ben gidduu (jechaan qofa barreeffame, fakkii malee):

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.
x-e-m1-01.thinking.0: Mallattoo sararoota baay'ee walitti qabuun murtee kennuu
x-e-m1-01.thinking.1: Jechoota danda'amuu akka 'might' fi 'probably' addaan baasuu
x-e-m1-01.thinking.2: Rakkoo murtaa'e rakkoo hafe irraa addaan baasuu
x-e-m1-01.prereq.0: Hiika jechoota salphaa akka might, probably, fi check with
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.prompt: Haasaa hanga dhumaatti dubbisiitii Ben ayyaana dhufuu isaa irratti murtee mijataa filadhu.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Jecha Ben kutaa afuritti qoodi: 'soccer game,' 'party time,' 'tired,' fi 'mom.'
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Yeroo taphaa kubbaa miillaa fi yeroo ayyaanaa cinaa-cinaa kaa'iitii wal-irra bu'uu moo hin bu'in wal bira qabi.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.a: 'Might' danda'amuu qofa ibsa. Duubatti ilaaliitii wanta Ben achi booda jedhe dubbistee mirkaneessi.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.b: Kun murtee rakkoo yeroo irratti wanta ta'e fi wanta ammallee hafe addaan baasu dha.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.c: Taphni kubbaa miillaa ganama, ayyaanni sa'aatii 4 p.m. dha. Yeroo lamaan cinaa-cinaa wal bira qabi.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.r.d: 'Tired' yaaddoo Ben ofiin dabale dha. Kana qofa akka diduu dubbisuu dandeessaa yaadi.
x-e-m1-01.s.s1.explain: Taphni kubbaa miillaa ganama, ayyaanni sa'aatii 4 p.m. dha, kanaaf yeroon wal-irra hin bu'u. Ben aarsaa ta'uu danda'a qofa jedhe, dhumarratti dura haadha isaa wajjin mirkaneessa jedhe. Kanaaf wanti murtaa'e (yeroo) fi wanti hafe (hayyama haadha isaa) jira, amma hin murtoofne.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.prompt: Sababa murtee armaan olii kennuuf hima lama ykn sadii Afaan Koreyaa'n barreessi. Jecha Afaan Ingilizii Ben tokko yoo xiqqaate hima, akkasumas wanti murtaa'e fi wanti hafe himi.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dura wanta murtaa'e tokko yeroo isaa wajjin barreessi.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Achiis wanta jecha Ben dhumaa keessa hafe argiitii barreessi.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ragaa yeroo fi wanta hafe lamaanuu kaaseettaa?
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Jecha Afaan Ingilizii Ben ragaa godhee hime?
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: 'Ni dhufa/hin dhufu' jedhee osoo hin mirkaneessin hafeettaa?
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.model.0: Taphni kubbaa miillaa ganama, ayyaanni sa'aatii 4 p.m. dha, kanaaf yeroon wal-irra hin bu'u. Garuu Ben 'Let me check with my mom first.' jedhe, kanaaf hayyamni haadha isaa hafeera, amma hin beekamu jedhee murteesse.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.model.1: 'That might work' jechuun ni danda'ama jechuu dha, taphni ganamaa fi ayyaanni 4 p.m. wal-irra hin bu'an. Aarsaa ta'uun yaaddoo qofa dha, dhumarratti dura haadha isaa wajjin mirkaneessa waan jedheef, murteen deebii haadha isaa irratti hundaa'a.
x-e-m1-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Deebii gaarii aarsaa ta'uu addaa madaale.

x-e-m1-02.title: 'That's fine.' jechuun dhugumaan sirrii dha jechuu dha?

x-e-m1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kutaa kana keessatti sagalee ykn jecha haaraa tokko argadhu.

x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.ask: Haasaa kana qofaa irraa, miira Sam irratti murteen sababa qabu kam?
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Sarara tokkoon murteessuu hin dandeessu. 'Fine' dhugumaan sirrii dha jechuu ni danda'a, ykn of-eegeen jedhamuu ni danda'a.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Inni gammade fakkaata, garuu mirkanaa'e miti.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: 'Fine' gaarii jechuu danda'a, kanaaf kun dubbisa danda'amu dha. Sagalee akka 'Oh.' fi '...' illee ilaali.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Jechoonni ykn ibsi inni aare jedhan ammaaf hin jiru. Deebii gabaabaa irraa miira cimaa murteessuun ragaa hin qabu.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Inni galata ni jedha, garuu wanti tokko isa rakkisaa jiraachuu danda'a.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: 'Oh.' fi '...' mallattoo godhatte. Sarara tokko qofa dha, kanaaf mirkanaa'uu hin dandeessu.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mallattoo haaraa dubbisiitii Sam dhugumaan maal akka barbaadu irra deebi'ii murteessi.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Sam karoora ayyaanaa akka qabu fi tikeetiin gati guddaa akka fakkaate, kanaaf dubbachuun ulfaataa akka ture dubbisuun mallattoo haaraa wajjin caalaatti walsima. Yoo jalqaba 'inni aare' jettee murteessite, as sirreessuu qabda.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Inni muuziqaa jaallachuu dhiisa, kanaaf kaayyoon cimaadhaan deebise.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Sam muuziqaa nan jibba hin jenne. Maaliif ayyaanni dhufe yaadi.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Tikeetiin gati guddaa waan ta'eef Abbaa komata.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: 'Look expensive' yaaddoo miira Abbaa jedhamee illee dubbifamuu danda'a. Sagaleen komachuu moo hin taane mallattoo barbaadi.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Inni ayyaana deemuu barbaada, garuu Abbaan miidhamuu waan danda'uuf jechuu hin dandeenye.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kun murtee mallattoo lama, karoora ayyaanaa fi tikeetii gati guddaa, walitti fayyadamu dha.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Hanga dhumaatti erga dubbistee booda, 'That's... fine.' jalqabaa akkamitti sirreessita?
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Ayyaanni sa'aatii 6 xumurama, muuziqaan sa'aatii 7:30 jalqaba, kanaaf lamaanuu deemuu danda'a. Dubbisa kee sirreessuu dandeessa: 'fine' jalqabaa hiika gubbaa fi hiika dhokataa adda ta'e qaba ture.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: 'Fine' mallattoo rakkoo ture, amma rakkoon sun furameera.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Sagalee jalqabaa fi deebii dhumaa walitti dubbistee.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Jalqabumaan rakkoon hin turre, 'fine' akkuma jirutti dhugaa ture.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Yoo rakkoon hin jiraanne ta'ee, Abbaan 'You don't sound happy.' hin jedhu ture, Sam illee ayyaana hin kaasu ture.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Rakkoon badeera sababni isaas Abbaan muuziqaa dhiise.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Muuziqaan hin dhiifamne. Yeroo lamaan, 7:30 fi 6:00, irra deebi'ii dubbisi.
x-e-m1-02.s.s1.reflect: Kutaa sadan dubbisaa osoo jirtu, iddoon murteen kee miira Sam irratti itti jijjiirame jiraa? Yoo jijjiirame, wanta dubbatame isa fide tokko yaadi.
x-e-m1-02.s.s2.prompt: Sarara mallattoon sagalee jalqabaa Sam 'That's... fine.' gammachuu dhugaa hin taane ta'uu danda'a jedhu itti mul'ate filadhu.
x-e-m1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Sarara Sam jalqaba jedhe keessatti, jechoota malees mallattoo ykn sagalee gabaabaa fayyadame barbaadi.
x-e-m1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Sarara kam Abbaan 'You don't sound happy.' jechuu dura jira?
x-e-m1-02.s.s2.explain: Sarara 2 keessatti, Sam 'Oh.' fi '...' fayyadamee 'fine' jedha. Sagaleen mamii agarsiisa. Sarara 3 Abbaan sagalee sana itti hubate dha, sarara 4 immoo sababni kallattiidhaan itti mul'atu dha.
